overview: Role-based enablement, runbook walkthroughs, supervised exercises and formal handover to named customer staff. The scope is built around asset inventories, detections and incident operating procedures, producing prioritised security controls, findings and rehearsed response. A customer-named ciso delegate approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is false positives, privileged access and evidence chain.

scope:

4) Acceptance: participant sign-off and completed tabletop simulation; verify false positives, privileged access and evidence chain.
5) Handover: runbooks, unresolved items, knowledge transfer and acceptance sign-off.
